themes_detail.label: Park Noise Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints in parks spiked to 4 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 3,100% increase with z-score of 11.72—suggesting a sudden, severe disruption to outdoor recreation spaces in Ridgewood/Glendale.
evidence: 4 park noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (3,100% spike)
Z-score of 11.72 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Community board has repeatedly requested park upgrades and reconstruction, suggesting infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: What specific parks are affected and what is causing the noise (events, construction, gathering)?
How does this spike compare to typical summer patterns—is this seasonal or anomalous?

themes_detail.label: Encampment Surge
themes_detail.summary: Homeless encampment complaints jumped to 7 THIS WEEK from a baseline of 0.9 per week—a 700% increase with z-score 4.83—indicating a rapid deterioration in street conditions and possible shelter capacity crisis affecting multiple neighborhoods.
evidence: 7 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike)
Z-score of 4.83 meets high severity threshold
Sustained street condition complaints (1,357 total over 90 days) suggest systemic infrastructure strain related to encampments
reporting_angles: Where are encampments concentrated and how long have they been established?
Are there gaps in outreach services, shelter capacity, or social services in this district?

themes_detail.label: Food Safety Red Flag
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints spiked to 7 THIS WEEK from a 2.6 weekly baseline—a 167% increase (z-score 5.11)—concurrent with 4 food poisoning complaints 2 weeks ago (433% above baseline), suggesting emerging hygiene or sanitation failures in the food service sector.
evidence: 7 food establishment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.6 weekly average (167% spike, z-score 5.11)
4 food poisoning complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.8 weekly average (433% spike, z-score 4.91)
Two-pronged signal: compliance failures + actual illness reports point to systemic food safety issue
reporting_angles: Which restaurants/food vendors are generating complaints and what violations are cited?
Has DOH increased inspection frequency and are there enforcement actions in progress?

themes_detail.label: Illegal Vending & Abandoned Bikes
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints surged to 6 THIS WEEK from 0.8 weekly baseline (700% spike, z-score 4.82), and abandoned bikes to 3 THIS WEEK from 0.4 baseline (700% spike, z-score 3.77), suggesting rapid deterioration of street order and informal economy enforcement lapses.
evidence: 6 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 4.82)
3 abandoned bike complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 3.77)
Both signal rapid street disorder requiring enforcement attention; parallel spikes suggest resource/staffing strain
reporting_angles: Are street vendors concentrated in specific commercial corridors (Fresh Pond Rd, Cypress Ave, etc.)?
Does enforcement backlog correlate with understaffing or enforcement priority shifts?

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dog & Animal Safety
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints spiked to 4 LAST WEEK from 0.4 weekly baseline (967% increase, z-score 7.49), and unsanitary animal complaints on private property hit 3 THIS WEEK from 0.8 baseline (300% increase, z-score 3.4), indicating both public safety and animal welfare concerns.
evidence: 4 unleashed dog complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (967% spike, z-score 7.49)
3 unsanitary animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average (300% spike, z-score 3.4)
Dual signal: both public space enforcement (parks) and private property violations spiking simultaneously
reporting_angles: Are specific parks or dog runs seeing the surge, and is off-leash culture deteriorating?
Are these complaints linked to hoarding or neglect situations requiring ACS intervention?
